mapper.select: SELECT U.COMPANY_CODE, U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.DEPT_NAME AS deptName, U.POSITION AS positionName, L.STATUS FROM TB_USER_MASTER U JOIN TB_LOGIN_MASTER L ON U.COMPANY_CODE = L.COMPANY_CODE AND U.USER_ID = L.USER_ID WHERE U.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND (#{userName} IS NULL OR U.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{userName} || '%') AND (#{dept} IS NULL OR U.DEPT_NAME = #{dept}) AND (#{position} IS NULL OR U.POSITION = #{position}) ORDER BY U.USER_NAME

SELECT M.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.PARENT_MENU_CODE, M.MENU_GROUP, M.MENU_URL, M.MENU_LEVEL, M.SORT_ORDER, MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CODE = 'READ' THEN A.AUTH_YN ELSE 'N' END) AS readAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CODE = 'CREATE' THEN A.AUTH_YN ELSE 'N' END) AS createAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CODE = 'UPDATE' THEN A.AUTH_YN ELSE 'N' END) AS updateAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CODE = 'DELETE' THEN A.AUTH_YN ELSE 'N' END) AS deleteAuth FROM TB_MENU_MASTER M LEFT JOIN TB_USER_MENU_AUTH A ON M.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND M.MENU_CODE = A.MENU_CODE AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE M.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND M.MENU_GROUP = #{menuGroup} GROUP BY M.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.PARENT_MENU_CODE, M.MENU_GROUP, M.MENU_URL, M.MENU_LEVEL, M.SORT_ORDER ORDER BY M.MENU_LEVEL, M.SORT_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER_MENU_AUTH (COMPANY_CODE, USER_ID, MENU_CODE, ACTION_CODE, AUTH_YN, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE) VALUES (#{companyCode}, #{userId}, #{menuCode}, #{actionCode}, #{authYn}, #{updatedBy}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT A.COMPANY_CODE, A.USER_ID, A.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN ACTION_CODE='READ' THEN AUTH_YN END) AS readAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN ACTION_CODE='CREATE' THEN AUTH_YN END) AS createAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN ACTION_CODE='UPDATE' THEN AUTH_YN END) AS updateAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN ACTION_CODE='DELETE' THEN AUTH_YN END) AS deleteAuth FROM TB_USER_MENU_AUTH A JOIN TB_MENU_MASTER M ON A.COMPANY_CODE = M.COMPANY_CODE AND A.MENU_CODE = M.MENU_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY A.COMPANY_CODE, A.USER_ID, A.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.SORT_ORDER ORDER BY M.SORT_ORDER
